model_result.answer_summary: Internal COF-2 honeycomb diameter d = sqrt(3) * a with a = 2*(B-O) + 2*(C-B) + 2*(C-C) = 2*(1.38) + 2*(1.56) + 2*(1.39) = 8.66 Å, giving d = 14.9996 Å ≈ 15.0 Å (three significant figures). Raw exact value sqrt(3)*8.66 Å is preserved unrounded in the Lean submission.
assumptions: Problem-stipulated inputs taken as exact constants: C-C/C=C (arenes) = 1.39 Å, C-B = 1.56 Å, B-O = 1.38 Å, and d = sqrt(3)*a for the circle inscribed in a regular hexagon of side a.
Problem-stipulated: neglect the width of the linkers.

Structural reading from the Q3-1 figure: COF-2 (from benzene-1,3,5-triboronic acid A2) is a honeycomb whose pore-hexagon vertices are B3O3 boroxine rings and whose sides are the collinear chain boroxine-centre -> B (1.38) - C-B (1.56) - benzene para crossing (2x1.39) - C-B (1.56) - boroxine-centre (1.38).

Elementary geometry used as a derived theorem-style premise: a regular hexagon of side s has circumradius s (applied to both the arene ring, para diameter = 2x1.39, and the boroxine ring, centre-to-B = 1.38); collinearity follows from trigonal 120-degree angles, consistent with the problem's uniform bond-length idealization and its own inscribed-circle note.
Reporting: uniform blind-evaluation default of three significant figures (quantum 0.1 Å), ties half away from zero (vacuous here since d > 14.95 strictly).
